cohort: The study participants were children from two ongoing French nationwide birth cohorts, initiated in 2011, who were followed up at age 10 (n = 8372 via telephone interview and n = 6418 via home visit).
finding: While most outcomes did not differ, strabismus was more prevalent among preterm and early term children, and moderate preterm children specifically showed lower WISC-V average scores and increased dental issues compared to full-term peers.
gest_age: 32-40 gestational weeks (categorized as moderate preterm 32-33 GA, late preterm 34-36 GA, early term 37-38 GA, and full-term 39-40 GA)
